protocol.prior_information: Original monthly, Nov 8–12 snapshot, and external transfer results were seen. NOAA-20 Nov 1 file access was probed. This is an exploratory diagnostic, not a new untouched final benchmark.

window.reason: Month start through last completed UTC day at the 14 November 2026 snapshot; not chosen by outcome.

protocol.sources: One global FIRMS daily file per sensor per date. Require all 26 valid tables before publishing the comparison. A present file is not proof of complete satellite observations.
protocol.reference: Aqua 2003–2017 identical calendar dates, fixed median and 90th percentile. Retain 2003–2025 history and NOAA-20 2019–2025.
protocol.calibration: Freeze original Indonesia NOAA-20 sector/quarter factors fitted 2019–2021; never refit on this window.
protocol.tests: All 48 month-start days 1–13 windows in 2022–2025, separately four November windows; publish all five predefined Indonesia regions. Leave one date out of current and historical windows together.
protocol.geography: Apply identical existing Indonesia polygon to global NRT and Indonesia country archives. Coarse display/region assignment at 0.25 degree cell centres. Archive country assignment can exclude coastal detections before this mask.
protocol.limits: NRT versus standard processing is unvalidated. No cloud/overpass denominator, no uncertainty interval, no forecast, no claim of distinct fires or area burned. No 2026 annual continuity implied.

limits: Provisional NRT-to-standard comparison; processing continuity is unvalidated.
All 26 daily files are available. This does not establish complete satellite observations, clear-sky coverage or all fires detected.
Month-to-date means 1–13 November 2026 only; 14 November is excluded and no other 2026 months are represented.
All thermal source types retained; detections and occupied cell-days are neither distinct fires nor area burned.
Frozen monthly calibration is evaluated on shorter windows; residuals are diagnostics, not a confidence interval.
Current inter-sensor agreement is not independent ground truth; only four same-calendar held-out years are available.
Country archive assignment may omit coastal records before the identical polygon mask.
Missing dates outside this pinned snapshot are unavailable, never zeros. This is not an automatically refreshed live feed.
